title: AML Transaction-Monitoring Policy Patterns
global_note: Every matched pattern produces an alert for human review, not a conclusion that money laundering occurred. Evaluate alerts with customer profile, expected activity, transaction history, supporting documents, and other red flags.

threshold_policy.official_thresholds: Values explicitly stated in the cited public guidance.
threshold_policy.configurable_demo_thresholds: Synthetic demo settings created for reproducible generation and evaluation. They are not regulatory thresholds or an actual bank policy.

sources.title: FFIEC BSA/AML Examination Manual - Appendix G: Structuring
FinCEN FIN-2014-A005 - Funnel Accounts and Trade-Based Money Laundering

official_red_flags: A currency sum over $10,000 is broken into smaller cash deposits or withdrawals at or below $10,000.
Structuring may occur across one or more banks and one or more days; a single-day $10,000 breach is not required.
patterns.detection_logic: For each customer or account, within any 7-day rolling window, generate an alert when at least 3 cash transactions are each between $8,000 and $9,999.99 and their aggregate exceeds $20,000. Compare the activity with expected cash behavior before escalation.
patterns.implementation_hint: Group cash transactions by customer/account; use a rolling time window; calculate count and aggregate amount.
legitimate_explanations: Routine activity of a documented cash-intensive business.
Near-threshold transactions separated in time without evidence of avoidance.
Documented sales proceeds or another verified source of cash.
evidence_required: Customer profile and expected cash activity

official_red_flags: Cash is used to buy official checks, money orders, or traveler's checks below applicable recordkeeping or reporting thresholds.
Deposited instruments are sequentially numbered, bought at multiple locations or on different days, or grouped below relevant thresholds.
Round-denomination instruments below $3,000 may lack complete payee information.
patterns.detection_logic: Per account, order deposited monetary instruments by type, date, and serial number. Generate an alert when at least 3 instruments within 7 days have consecutive or near-consecutive serials and are individually below $3,000 or collectively display threshold-avoidance characteristics, especially when amounts are round or payee data is missing.
patterns.implementation_hint: Build serial-number runs and evaluate instrument count, amount, payee completeness, purchase location, and time window.
legitimate_explanations: Payroll or vendor checks issued sequentially by a legitimate business.
Money orders purchased for documented rent or bill payments.

official_red_flags: An account receives multiple cash deposits below $10,000 at branches outside its home or operating region.
Business deposits are made far from where the business operates.
Deposits are made by unidentified persons or non-customers.
patterns.detection_logic: Within 14 days, generate an alert when an account receives at least 3 sub-$10,000 cash deposits from at least 2 states outside the customer's documented operating region and at least 50% of its cash-deposit count is out of region.
patterns.implementation_hint: Compare branch state with documented domicile and operating states; aggregate count, distinct states, and out-of-region share.
legitimate_explanations: Documented multi-state operations or traveling sales staff.
Recent relocation not yet reflected in KYC.
Known family members or employees depositing for the account holder.
evidence_required: Relationship between depositors and account owner

patterns.pattern_name: Funnel account: rapid out-movement and consolidation
official_red_flags: Funds are withdrawn in a different geographic area with little time between deposits and withdrawals.
Multiple funnel accounts transfer funds into one consolidated account.
Wires or checks move from the funnel account to domestic or foreign businesses.
patterns.detection_logic: For an account matching TM-03 or similar funnel indicators, generate an alert when at least 80% of the relevant inflows leave the same checking account within 72 hours. Consolidation across multiple accounts is outside the initial demo scope.
patterns.implementation_hint: Match out-of-region cash deposits to subsequent outgoing checks or wires from the same checking account; calculate elapsed hours and the outflow-to-inflow ratio.
legitimate_explanations: Normal supplier payments from a cash-intensive business.
Documented treasury sweeps among commonly owned accounts.

patterns.pattern_name: Business-account activity unrelated to stated business
official_red_flags: Debits from a business account receiving unusual deposits do not fit the account holder's stated business.
An import business receives payments from parties outside its expected customer base.
Checks or wires go to foreign businesses with no apparent relationship to the account holder.
patterns.detection_logic: Within 30 days, generate an alert when at least $5,000 and at least 30% of business-account outflows go to counterparties whose industries or countries are outside the customer's documented expected activity.
patterns.implementation_hint: Join transactions to an allowed industry-country mapping and calculate mismatched amount and share of total outflows.
legitimate_explanations: Documented business expansion or new supplier line.
Incomplete or outdated customer profile.

patterns.pattern_name: Small cash deposits followed by foreign ATM withdrawals
official_red_flags: A checking account receives cash deposits below $1,000 several times a month, followed by ATM withdrawals in foreign countries.

official_thresholds.deposit_frequency: Several per month; no exact numeric value stated.

patterns.detection_logic: Generate an alert when an account receives at least 3 sub-$1,000 cash deposits in a month and has at least 2 foreign ATM withdrawals, including a withdrawal occurring within 7 days after a qualifying deposit.
patterns.implementation_hint: Aggregate small deposits monthly and match them to later foreign ATM withdrawals.
legitimate_explanations: Documented frequent international travel.
A student or worker with legitimate small cash income.
Documented family-support activity.

patterns.pattern_name: Pass-through activity with same or nearly same amounts
official_red_flags: Funds are received and then sent out in the same or nearly the same amounts.
Origin or destination locations may involve jurisdictions of concern identified in the applicable advisory or current bank risk assessment.
patterns.detection_logic: Generate an alert when at least 2 incoming transactions of $5,000 or more are followed within 3 days by outgoing transactions within 5% of the incoming amounts, especially when an involved country conflicts with the customer profile or appears in the demo jurisdiction-risk table.
patterns.implementation_hint: Pair credits and later debits by account, time, and amount tolerance; do not hard-code an outdated country list into production logic.
legitimate_explanations: Legitimate import-export intermediary.
Documented escrow, settlement, or payment-processing activity.

patterns.pattern_name: Sudden onset and cessation of wire activity
official_red_flags: Payments, typically wires, begin suddenly and stop equally suddenly within a short period, suggesting temporary use of the account.
patterns.detection_logic: Generate an alert when an account has at least 60 quiet days, then a wire burst lasting no more than 45 days with at least 5 wires totaling at least $50,000, followed by another 60 quiet days, and the burst conflicts with expected activity.
patterns.implementation_hint: Identify contiguous wire-activity periods and calculate quiet periods before and after each burst.
legitimate_explanations: Seasonal business activity.
A documented one-time project or asset transaction.
Legitimate onboarding activity in a new account.

patterns.pattern_name: International wires involving unrelated third parties or incomplete information
official_red_flags: An intermediary apparently unrelated to the buyer or seller makes a third-party payment.
There is no apparent business relationship between originator and beneficiary.
The ordering party's residence is inconsistent with the country from which the wire originates.
Originator, beneficiary, or payment-purpose information is missing.
Frequent wires use round or whole-dollar amounts.

official_thresholds.frequency: Frequent; no exact numeric value stated.

patterns.detection_logic: Within 90 days, generate an alert when an account has at least 5 international wires and either at least 60% use round amounts or one or more wires involve unknown counterparties, missing payment information, or country-profile inconsistencies. Require stronger review when multiple indicators occur together.
patterns.implementation_hint: Calculate wire count and round-amount share; test counterparty familiarity, required-field completeness, residency-country consistency, and expected-country match.
legitimate_explanations: Contractually fixed payments.
A newly onboarded legitimate supplier.
Documented parent-company, agent, or intermediary payments.

patterns.pattern_name: Non-resident multi-account and geographically dispersed activity
official_red_flags: A foreign visitor opens multiple U.S. accounts at one or more institutions.
Cash deposits are made over the counter while checkbooks or cards are used abroad.
Deposits occur across multiple U.S. jurisdictions and withdrawals occur through foreign ATMs.
Related persons maintain multiple accounts used for structured deposits or payments to unrelated foreign businesses.
patterns.detection_logic: Within 60 days, generate an alert for a non-resident or visitor with at least 2 accounts, over-the-counter cash deposits in at least 2 states, and at least 2 foreign ATM withdrawals, especially when activity conflicts with the customer's documented purpose and travel profile.
patterns.implementation_hint: Aggregate at customer and related-household levels across all accounts, branches, and ATM countries.
legitimate_explanations: Documented student, tourist, or temporary-worker activity.
Legitimate family members maintaining separate accounts.

official_red_flags: Multiple cash deposits into an account on the same day collectively exceed the CTR threshold.
Cash deposits occur at multiple branches, potentially including branches in different states.
patterns.detection_logic: For each account and business day, generate an alert when cash deposits collectively exceed $10,000 and occur at 2 or more branches. Increase review priority when branches span multiple states or depositors are unrelated to the customer.
patterns.implementation_hint: Aggregate cash deposits by account and date; count distinct branches, states, and depositors.
legitimate_explanations: A business with multiple documented locations depositing daily receipts.
Documented armored-car or courier consolidation.

patterns.pattern_name: Sequential checks through foreign MSBs or correspondent channels
official_red_flags: Sequentially numbered checks drawn on U.S. accounts are negotiated through foreign money-services businesses.
Checks are payable directly to a casa de cambio or other foreign MSB.
Checks or wires from a funnel account are deposited into or cleared through a foreign bank's U.S. correspondent account or cash-letter channel.
patterns.detection_logic: Within 14 days, generate an alert when at least 3 sequentially numbered checks totaling at least $10,000 are payable to or cleared through a foreign MSB, casa de cambio, correspondent account, or cash-letter channel, and the activity is inconsistent with the customer's stated business.
patterns.implementation_hint: Identify check-number sequences, then aggregate count and amount by account, payee type, and clearing channel.
legitimate_explanations: Documented remittance or currency-exchange activity.
Legitimate supplier payments to foreign vendors.

initial_synthesis_plan.note: TM-03 and TM-04 form one combined funnel-account scenario, so six enabled pattern records support five customer scenarios.

excluded_from_transaction_only_detection.reason: Requires document-image analysis or manual review.

excluded_from_transaction_only_detection.indicator: Amended letters of credit or discrepancies among bills of lading, invoices, and packing lists
excluded_from_transaction_only_detection.reason: Requires trade-document fields and document comparison.

excluded_from_transaction_only_detection.indicator: Customer cannot produce documentation or a depositor lacks knowledge of the business
Over-invoicing, under-invoicing, double invoicing, or price, quantity, and quality mismatch
excluded_from_transaction_only_detection.reason: Requires invoices, goods data, and external or internal pricing references.
Requires KYC and beneficial-ownership data rather than transactions alone.

sar_note: The cited FinCEN advisories may request specific SAR narrative terms where applicable. Those terms are reporting guidance, not transaction-detection rules.
disclaimer: This file is a synthetic demonstration configuration derived from public guidance. It is not an actual bank policy, legal advice, or a determination that any person or transaction involves money laundering.
